greetings.text: Oh. It's you. What do you want?
Do mind the carpets. They are new. Well, newish. Well, they will be.
Yes? I am extremely busy. Make it quick.

farewells.text: Good day to you. Mind the step. And do not touch that.

smalltalk.text: I always said Bag End was too good for that Frodo. I always did.
There is a great deal to be done to this house. It has been shockingly neglected.
My Lotho has a head for business. He will go far. Further than certain Bagginses.
Nobody ever listens to me, and I am always proved right. Always!
It is a scandal, those Gamgees and their potatoes.

frodo_sold_bag_end.text: Of course I bought Bag End. I paid a perfectly proper price. Whatever anyone says.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: A black rider? Nonsense. Trespassers, probably, who have no business in the Shire. I shall write to the Mayor.
